content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed the terms and would like to request one small adjustment before signing. - Regarding the payment terms in the relevant clause, where it states 'Invoices are payable Net 40', I would like to propose changing this to 'Invoices are payable Net 30' to align with my standard billing practices. Best regards.
